# `<sl-tag>` — Tag

> **Customized in Saipem DS.** It differs from upstream Shoelace: `variant` accepts new values: 'accent'. Use only the API below.

Tags are used as labels to organize things or to indicate a selection.

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tag/tag.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon-button>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | — | `primary`, `accent`, `success`, `neutral`, `warning`, `danger`, `text` | `'neutral'` | The tag's theme variant. |
| `size` | — | `small`, `medium`, `large` | `'medium'` | The tag's size. |
| `pill` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws a pill-style tag with rounded edges. |
| `removable` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the tag removable and shows a remove button. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-remove` | — | Emitted when the remove button is activated. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The tag's content. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `content` | The tag's content. |
| `remove-button` | The tag's remove button, an `<sl-icon-button>`. |
| `remove-button__base` | The remove button's exported `base` part. |

## Documentation and examples

```html
<sl-tag variant="primary">Primary</sl-tag>
<sl-tag variant="success">Success</sl-tag>
<sl-tag variant="neutral">Neutral</sl-tag>
<sl-tag variant="warning">Warning</sl-tag>
<sl-tag variant="danger">Danger</sl-tag>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tag/tag.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tag-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-tag variant="primary">Primary</sl-tag>
    <sl-tag variant="success">Success</sl-tag>
    <sl-tag variant="neutral">Neutral</sl-tag>
    <sl-tag variant="warning">Warning</sl-tag>
    <sl-tag variant="danger">Danger</sl-tag>
  `
})
export class TagExampleComponent {}
```

> **Tip:** A tag labels a record (a category, an applied filter, the current revision in a description list). For a value that
> changes through the workflow, such as a task's progress, use a [status](status.md) instead — with `filled`
> when it needs to stand out.
## Examples

### Sizes

Use the `size` attribute to change a tag's size.

```html
<sl-tag size="small">Small</sl-tag>
<sl-tag size="medium">Medium</sl-tag>
<sl-tag size="large">Large</sl-tag>
```

### Pill

Use the `pill` attribute to give tags rounded edges.

```html
<sl-tag size="small" pill>Small</sl-tag>
<sl-tag size="medium" pill>Medium</sl-tag>
<sl-tag size="large" pill>Large</sl-tag>
```

### Removable

Use the `removable` attribute to add a remove button to the tag.

```html
<div class="tags-removable">
  <sl-tag size="small" removable>Small</sl-tag>
  <sl-tag size="medium" removable>Medium</sl-tag>
  <sl-tag size="large" removable>Large</sl-tag>
</div>

<script>
  const div = document.querySelector('.tags-removable');

  div.addEventListener('sl-remove', event => {
    const tag = event.target;
    tag.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => (tag.style.opacity = '1'), 2000);
  });
</script>

<style>
  .tags-removable sl-tag {
    transition: var(--sl-transition-medium) opacity;
  }
</style>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tag/tag.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tag-removable-example',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  styles: `
    sl-tag {
      transition: var(--sl-transition-medium) opacity;
    }
  `,
  template: `
    <div (sl-remove)="onRemove($event)">
      <sl-tag size="small" removable>Small</sl-tag>
      <sl-tag size="medium" removable>Medium</sl-tag>
      <sl-tag size="large" removable>Large</sl-tag>
    </div>
  `
})
export class TagRemovableExampleComponent {
  onRemove(event: Event) {
    const tag = event.target as HTMLElement;
    tag.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => (tag.style.opacity = '1'), 2000);
  }
}
```
